'''Saviel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was present on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Saviel appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. She is involved in the [[Sith Inquisitor]] class missions "Taking Inquisitor" and "Battles to Be Won," which are the ending missions for Chapters 1 and 2 of the class storyline respectively and see players visit Saviel&mdash;who does not speak&mdash;to receive a small reward.<ref name="TOR" />
